There's more than you'd think really.

Diablo I-III, Divinity Original Sin, Pillars of Eternity, Torchlight 1-2, Neverwinter, and several other top down RPG titles can be played that way. You can access anything you need from the hud display, including menus and such.

RTS games can often be played this way as well, especially the single player modes.

Pretty much any Adventure game is usually played with only the mouse. Grim Fandago, Deponia, Broken Age, Monkey Island, Sam and Max, anything by Telltale Games, etc...

The Sims is another game that can easily be played with only the mouse. This goes for pretty much any Sid Meier game as well. Civilization I-V can all easily be played mouse only.

Most top down Tower Defense type games can be played mouse only.

This is even more true if you get a gaming mouse with a few extra programmable buttons on it, or better yet one with a num pad on the side. They can be had cheaper than most people realize.

I've got a Redragon Perdition and I love it, play lots of stuff mouse only easily with it. It's dirt cheap for a gaming mouse, well constructed and doesn't feel cheap at all. It has three extra top buttons, including one right next to left click that I usually map to 'use'. Plus a large sturdy mouse wheel, and a twelve button pad on the side with a wave pattern for easy no look navigation with my thumb.

There's tons of stuff to play with only the mouse even if you have a standard right left and scroll wheel only style mouse. A gaming mouse with extra buttons just makes things more convenient due to being able to program some of the hotkeys.

Sure, some of these games are slightly more convenient to play with a keyboard, but you don't really need it and they can be enjoyed without one easily without any real handicap, at least as far as single player goes. In competitive play you'll probably get wrecked playing mouse only against someone using a mouse and keyboard, but if you're just playing on your own it's totally viable.

You have plenty of options for mouse only gaming.
